findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: livonian_get_inflections · Public sink: latin_search, slavonic_search, scythian_search, norse_search, latgalian_search, anglo_search.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: livonian_get_inflections · Public sink: latin_search, slavonic_search, scythian_search, norse_search, latgalian_search, anglo_search

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
